summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests adding CTX-009 to standard gemcitabine, cisplatin, and durvalumab as first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer. All study drugs are given by IV, and participants receive treatment on an outpatient basis; how often and for how long are not stated. The main outcome the study measures is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa agregar CTX-009 al tratamiento estándar con gemcitabina, cisplatino y durvalumab como primera línea para cáncer de vías biliares no resecable o metastásico. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por vía intravenosa y el tratamiento es ambulatorio; la frecuencia y la duración no están indicadas. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Biliary tract cancer that is unresectable, advanced, metastatic, or recurrent, with no prior treatment in the metastatic setting.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 criteria.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney, and albumin levels within 14 days of treatment.
not_for: Prior treatment for the current cancer, except perioperative (adjuvant or neoadjuvant) treatment.
History of active interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Antiplatelet or anticoagulant drug use within 2 weeks before screening, or expected need during the study.
